about: Dependency rules between tenancy facts and attachments that rules.json does not encode but a coherent file must respect. Read by generator/design.py (kinds in README, 'Dependency rules'); each adjustment is logged in the design. Revised 2026-11-12 after the round-1 blind check: a 'not mentioned' answer is not allowed where a stated answer or an attached document implies an answer.

constraints.note: rent already paid into deposit implies the tenant has begun to pay on deposit
no deposit intended (rent paid as usual) or still undecided: no rent has been deposited (round 1: ten_270f84d8acff, ten_404e03b3e37f)
unclear whether a rent payment went into deposit: the tenant has at least begun to arrange paying on deposit (round 1: ten_6c5828c1c68b read the deposit intention as open)
a landlord who does not know of the defect has not learned of it orally: the oral-only question is answered no (round 1: ten_8c1d86a176c0, ten_aba30f049af3, ten_cf02cc821948, ten_e94fb7461784)
whether the landlord knows is open: how he learned of it cannot be stated
a landlord who learned of the defect orally (or whether only orally is open) knows of it (round 1: ten_404e03b3e37f, ten_6d6fcb65d5b6)
with the increase open, an increase notice giving cost reasons cannot be stated to exist

constraints.item: how and when the landlord learned of the defect
constraints.note: a written proof of how and when the landlord learned of the defect shows that he knows (round 1: ten_2249a3b45704, ten_6c5828c1c68b)

constraints.item: how and when the landlord learned of the defect
constraints.note: a written notice, acknowledgement or inspection record exists, so the landlord did not learn only orally (round 1: ten_2249a3b45704, ten_6c5828c1c68b)
the notice's stated reasons answer whether costs or services are the reason (round 1: ten_b4d4cb05336f, ten_efa24ba18ce3)

constraints.item: the reasons the landlord gave for the notice (on the notice, or given on request)
constraints.note: precaution, not observed in round 1: the landlord's stated reasons answer whether the notice was for arrears
